name: SaveFlagTableSnapshot
evidence: clears the word at +0x20C, copies the 0x204-byte bitmap block at +8 to the second block, stores its two arguments at 0x424 and 0x428 and sets the saved flag at 0x42C

name: StartScreenFadeFromFlagTable
evidence: starts a screen fade (func_001EFFA0 on g_screenFade) with the table's saved values at 0x424 and 0x428 when the saved flag at 0x42C is set, else with -1, -1; func_001E5278 calls it with D_00261420

name: RestoreFlagTableSnapshot
evidence: clears the counter at +4, copies the saved 0x204-byte block back over the bitmap at +8 and clears the changed flag at +0x20C

name: TakeFlagTableIndex
evidence: adds 1 to the counter at +4 of the table D_00261420 and returns it; class 0x38, 0x28, the 0x2F class and others call it at set-up to get their own bit index

name: TestFlagTableBit
evidence: returns whether bit (index & 7) of byte index / 8 of the table's bitmap at +0xC is set; the callers pass the table D_00261420 and an index func_00140FF8 gave out

name: SetFlagTableBit
evidence: sets that bit in the bitmap at +0xC, counts it (+8) and raises the changed flag at +0x20C when it was clear

name: ClearFlagTableBit
evidence: clears that bit of the bitmap at +0xC, uncounts it (+8) and raises the changed flag at +0x20C when it was set

name: ReadObjectTransformAndTables
evidence: reads a buffered rotation to +0x50, a vector to +0x40 and four mesh table words to +0x80..0x8C, then the property records

name: InitFlaggedObject
evidence: Slot 0 of class 0x38: takes a bit index from the table at D_00261420 into flagIndex, sets childId to -1, counts itself in the world.

name: CollectChildLists
evidence: Slot 10 of class 0x38: walks the children and appends those of kind 0x7B to objsB and kind 0x83 to objsA.

name: ResolveListIds
evidence: Slot 15 of class 0x38: looks up each id of idsA and idsB in the world and appends the found objects to objsA and objsB.

name: StartFlaggedObject
evidence: slot 16 of class 0x38: runs the base start func_00124A48, starts every entry of objsA and objsB with func_00182ED8, finds the child of kind 0x74 (or looks it up by childId), makes the handle for f5A8 and raises state 0x547 when the object's bit is set

name: CopyFlaggedObject
evidence: slot 9 of class 0x38: keeps flagIndex and ordinal across the collider copy func_001BA130, then replaces every entry of objsA and objsB with a copy made by func_00183058

name: UpdateFlaggedObject
evidence: original assembly; slot 17 (+0x54) of class 0x38, the flagged object's class (InitFlaggedObject at slot 0), the update slot

name: HandleFlaggedObjectEvent
evidence: the 0xC4 slot of class 0x38: when the event's type equals what func_001925F0 returns it plays func_0016EC38 (unless extraFlags 0x10), runs RaiseObjectFlag and returns 1; otherwise defers to HandleObjectEvent

name: RaiseObjectFlag
evidence: Sets the object's bit (flagIndex) in the table at D_00261420 and sends the handle to state 0x548 or 0x549 depending on the old bit.

name: AppendFlaggedObjectIdB
evidence: appends an id to idsB of a class 0x38 object (count at 0x578), the ids ResolveListIds looks up into objsB

name: AppendFlaggedObjectIdA
evidence: appends an id to idsA of a class 0x38 object (count at 0x550), the ids ResolveListIds looks up into objsA

name: SetFlaggedChildId
evidence: Stores its argument in childId (0x5A0) of a class 0x38 object.
